Question: Internal estimate
Recommendation: Report leave-pair-out AUC, not pooled LOOCV (errors -0.60 to +0.29 vs. +/-0.08)

Question: Internal estimate
Recommendation: Repeated k-fold, AUC per fold; expect >0.1 overstatement in about one study in five (17-23% at N = 20-30)

Question: Own null
Recommendation: Re-run the whole pipeline on permuted labels with leave-pair-out or per-fold k-fold; a mean well above 0.5 exposes a leak (at 3 vs 3 only 20 labellings exist, so a permutation p cannot fall below 0.05, or 0.1 for label-symmetric pipelines)

Question: Feature selection
Recommendation: Inside the folds only (outside: +0.04 to +0.45 optimism)

Question: Augmentation
Recommendation: Never before the split (SMOTE adds 0.07-0.16 from N = 20 on top of other leaks); inside the folds it does not help

Question: Model
Recommendation: Avoid the fusion network (TabPFN from N = 9, CCP and RF from 12, EN from 20; by 0.04-0.19 AUC)

Question: Model
Recommendation: No basis to choose among CCP, elastic net, random forest, TabPFN

Question: Outside information
Recommendation: If a labelled cohort exists for the same contrast, score with its signature: it beat all four standard models at N = 12 and 30; protein embeddings added nothing

Question: Features
Recommendation: With RF, use proteins, not pathway scores (EN: N = 30 only)

Question: Biomarker list
Recommendation: Do not read the top 50 as a biomarker list (Kuncheva 0.00-0.04)

Question: Stability
Recommendation: Not a proxy for recovery at a fixed N, and high even with no signal

Question: Large effect
Recommendation: Every method reaches a median AUC of 0.99-1.00 from N = 6 (B1, full-cohort |d| ~ 4); no basis to choose
